decisions.reason: The title incorrectly made the determinant value scale invariant: for n=1, A=1, B=0, p(0,1)=1 but p(0,2)=2. The Statement and both proof steps correctly give c^n homogeneity and invariant vanishing. Corrected only the title to distinguish the two; the mathematics, prerequisites and contract remain unchanged.

The rejected decomposition is explicitly proved in the cited supplier, lem-scaled-complex-householder-and-givens-local-backward-error, Proof 4.1: normalized exact target residual <=(u+2q)||r||, and overwriting the rounded target costs <=(u+2q+v_source)||r||. Its Proof 3.2 supplies the raw coefficient. Replacing sqrt(2) by 2 enlarges v_source to the current v, yielding h=u+2q+v and eta=v+h. Thus F2 accurately cites an established part of the supplier proof even though its Statement packages the complete bound.

The claimed triangularity failure ignores the zero being chased. At descending index j, T[j+1,j+1]=0 by the preceding zero move (initially T[k,k]=0), and triangularity gives T[j+1,j]=0. Hence right multiplication of columns j,j+1 acts on the zero lower row (0,0), creating no T subdiagonal. The target overwrite sets T[j,j]=0. The following left action on rows j+1,j+2 preserves triangularity since both entries of column j+1 are zero; it removes the sole H[j+2,j] bulge. The final left action preserves T column a, which is zero in the active block, and isolates the infinite pair. This is also explicitly established in the correctness proposition, Proof 1.2.

The concrete formula is explicitly qualified in the Statement: structural writes are included in E_j and there are only separate tolerance writes D_tol,j. Under that hypothesis the complete D_j ledger equals the tolerance ledger, so the accumulation lemma gives exactly the displayed sum. The algorithm prescribes no additional non-target, non-tolerance overwrite in its rotation schedules; its instruction to record all OTHER explicit zero writes prevents silent discards, rather than requiring an additional write. If any such discard were added, the generic first bound would include its norm and the concrete formula’s only-tolerance hypothesis would not hold. Thus no error term is silently omitted from the stated implication.
